_note: Alternate month spellings accepted by the date parser (guide 7.6, D-14), added to the canonical names from strings.{en,ne}.json. Keys are BS month numbers 1-12. Latin entries are lower case. Entries beyond the guide's list (asoj/ashwin, poush/paush, ashadh/asar, jestha/jeth, baisakh/baishakh) are common spellings added without a source: review with a native speaker. The generator fails if one spelling maps to two months.
